<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one peak falls in the typical methyl carbon region (≈10‑30 ppm): the signal at 26.29 ppm. The other low‑field signal at 43.30 ppm is more consistent with a carbon attached to an electronegative atom or a methylene, not a methyl. Therefore, the molecule contains a single methyl (CH₃) group.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
